newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI ARABIA - FEB 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI ARABIA - FEB 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Defence Minister Prince Sultan to visit Paris on February 22 for talks with French defence minister.
- United Sugar Company's refining plant in Saudi Arabia will start commercial production shortly, official says.
- The Saudi Consolidated Electricity Company-West accelerates work on key projects; pursues labour efficiency plan.
- Saudi Arabia and Japan to cooperate in petroleum and petrochemical areas, official says.
